facts.fact: ARTICLE 19 says Morocco's Law 31-13 on the Right to Access Information, adopted in 2018, came into effect in March 2020.
facts.system: Law 31-13 on the Right to Access Information

facts.fact: ARTICLE 19 says the members of Morocco's Commission for the Right to Access Information (CDAI), which oversees Law 31-13, were appointed in March 2019.
